name: Wacom Express Key Remote for Cintiq & Intuos Pro (ACK411050)
name_ar: Wacom Express Key Remote for Cintiq & Intuos Pro (ACK411050)
summary: Wacom Express Key Remote for Cintiq & Intuos Pro (ACK411050) - ACK411050 - - ExpressKey™ Remote is designed to help boost your productivity. With 17 customizable buttons and a Touch Ring it offers time–saving shortcuts for all your favorite creative
description_html:
ExpressKey™ Remote is designed to help boost your productivity. With 17 customizable buttons and a Touch Ring it offers time–saving shortcuts for all your favorite creative applications. You can connect up to five ExpressKey™ Remotes at a time (one for each creative software applications) to optimize your workflow. Compatible with Wacom Cintiq Pro or Cintiq pen displays, Wacom Mobile Studio Pro or Cintiq Companion Pen computers, and Wacom Intuos Pro pen tablets.


Features

17 customizable buttons for quick shortcuts

Touch Ring features three different modes: Auto zoom/scroll, brush size and rotate

Rechargable battery included

Must be paired using ExpressKey™ Remote wireless receiver plugged into USB port



Compatible with

  • Wacom One (DTC133)

  • Cintiq 13 (DTK1301)

  • Cintiq 22 (DTK2200, DTH2200)

  • Cintiq 27 (DTK2700, DTH2700)

  • Wacom Cintiq Pro 13&16 (DTH1320, DTH1620)

  • Wacom Cintiq Pro 24 (DTK2420, DTH2420)

  • Wacom Cintiq Pro 32 (DTH3220)

  • Wacom MobileStudio Pro (DTHW1320, DTHW1620, DTHW1621H)

  • Wacom Cintiq 16 (DTK-1660)

  • Wacom Cintiq 22 (DTK-2260)


What's included

ExpressKey™ Remote

Rechargeable battery

Wireless receiver

Micro USB cable

Quick Start Guide
